avoid_supplements.name: Warfarin/Anticoagulants
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet function and increase bleeding risk; tolmetin may displace warfarin from protein binding, elevating INR
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor INR closely and reduce anticoagulant dose

avoid_supplements.name: Lithium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Tolmetin reduces renal clearance of lithium, leading to toxic accumulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if unavoidable, monitor lithium levels and renal function regularly

avoid_supplements.name: ACE Inhibitors/Angiotensin Receptor Blockers
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce efficacy of antihypertensives and increase risk of acute renal injury and hyperkalemia
avoid_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor blood pressure, renal function, and potassium levels

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider alternative herbal supplement

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet properties may potentiate tolmetin's antiplatelet effects
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor for excessive bleeding or bruising

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor antiplatelet activity may add to NSAID effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased bleeding risk with concurrent use

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (chronic/excessive)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Alcohol increases GI irritation and bleeding risk; elevates risk of tolmetin-induced GI ulceration and hepatotoxicity
avoid_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; counsel on GI protective measures

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: NSAIDs increase sodium retention; excessive dietary sodium may exacerbate fluid retention and hypertension
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to moderate salt intake and monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit
caution_foods.mechanism: May inhibit CYP2C9 metabolism, though clinical significance is minimal with tolmetin
caution_foods.action: Monitor for increased GI side effects; generally safe in moderation

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function, blood pressure, and signs of GI bleeding, particularly in elderly patients or those with renal impairment. Assess for drug interactions with antihypertensives, anticoagulants, and lithium; tolmetin should be used at the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible.
